measurement.quantity: L2 gas (Sierra gas) of the case's one top-level call from the test, inclusive of the calls it makes (e.g. get_midi includes the NFT's get_beast_rank)
measurement.source: the [L2 gas] of that call in `snforge test --trace-components contract-name gas`
measurement.snforge_mode: --no-optimization (contracts from the bench package's starknet-contract target, checked identical to the root scarb build)
measurement.excludes: the test body (deploys, mock setup, output digests) and transaction overheads

derived.note: net = probe - its input-only (or return-cost) probe; see bench/README.md
